requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions tailored for SMBs into the Magellan printer. This includes features such as automated document handling, smart scan optimization, and AI-driven device management.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB need for efficiency and ease of management, especially where IT resources are limited.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration, compatible hardware, and SMB portal support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Demonstrable AI-powered features in the product UI; workflow automation; measurable improvement in management tasks; positive feedback in SMB user testing.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO for SMBs, with minimal intervention required for maintenance and supplies.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs prioritize ROI and cost-efficiency; low TCO is a key differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires efficient consumables, high-yield tanks, and minimal service interventions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented TCO analysis showing Magellan has lowest TCO in HP SMB portfolio; validated by third-party or internal cost models.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Components (PHA, Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Enable customer replaceability for key components (e.g., PHA, maintenance box) to reduce downtime and service costs. If out of warranty, service center support is required.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT; reducing service dependency and downtime is critical.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design must allow safe and easy user replacement; service documentation required.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace specified components without technical support; replacement process validated in user testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent user errors and ensure compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces risk of incorrect refilling and supports warranty/service quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design of ink tank and bottle interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottle system prevents incorrect installation in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated SMB portal for device and fleet management, targeting unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Simplifies printer management for non-IT users, improving efficiency and user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software development, integration with device firmware, and UX design for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is functional, user-friendly, and supports management of multiple devices; positive SMB user feedback.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Platform as a Service)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports Platform as a Service (PaaS) for cloud-enabled solutions and services.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses future-proofing and integration with evolving SMB IT environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires cloud connectivity and compliance with HP PaaS ecosystem.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan can be registered and managed through HP PaaS platform; passes integration tests.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL and PDL SKU Differentiation
requirements.Description: Offer both Non-PDL and PDL SKUs with differentiated features: Non-PDL with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal; PDL SKU with improved print speed (25/20 ppm) and PDL/PS support.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses different SMB needs and use-cases; expands market coverage.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires SKU management, firmware variations, and testing for each variant.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Both SKUs available; features validated as per specifications; performance benchmarks met.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU achieves Blue Angel environmental certification.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability goals and competitive positioning, especially in regulated markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compliance with Blue Angel criteria and certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU receives official Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: High Sustainability (60% RCP)
requirements.Description: Magellan must achieve 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP) in its construction, exceeding key competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability objectives and provides a market differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing and manufacturing with high RCP; supply chain alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product BOM and third-party certification confirm 60% RCP; marketing claims substantiated.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box Feature
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box as a new feature for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses new customer segment needs and reduces service downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design and user documentation; field test validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace maintenance box; feature validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years (Whichever First)
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty covering 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Meets SMB expectations for reliability and cost control.
requirements.Dependencies: Warranty policy and service infrastructure alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms clearly communicated; support infrastructure in place; tracked in warranty system.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement advanced telemetry features for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and usage analytics, supporting both HP and SMB customer needs.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, fleet management, and product improvement.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires telemetry hardware/software integration; privacy/compliance review.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data accessible via portal; supports diagnostics; compliant with regulations.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Support
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing functionality and full support through the HP App.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs expect mobile-first solutions and app-based management.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires app integration, firmware support, and user documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing tested on major platforms; HP App fully supports Magellan; user acceptance testing passed.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Deliver AI-driven 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' features for superior print and scan quality, error reduction, and workflow efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Key differentiator for Magellan; aligns with SMB need for quality and productivity.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI feature development, integration, and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Features available in product; quality improvements measurable; positive SMB feedback.
